summary: Iteration 25: All 37 tests passing (100%). Batches A/B/C fully verified. key_findings.batch_a_macro_events_fully_working: GET returns active_events (List[str]) + all_events (15 items with key/description/active). POST update sets MongoDB macro_config collection. Invalid keys correctly return 422 with descriptive message including the bad key and valid options. Empty events=[] clears state. Persistence verified: GET after POST shows active=True flags.
key_findings.batch_b_forensic_confluence_verified: Direct unit test via imported _calculate_confluence_score_master_spec confirms: (1) piotroski >=7→fundamental=10, >=5→7, >=3→4, <3→2. (2) beneish_m_score>-2.22 subtracts exactly 3. (3) altman DISTRESS subtracts exactly 4. (4) altman SAFE adds exactly 2 (capped at 10). (5) Combined penalties accumulate: DISTRESS+beneish = -7. (6) No forensic data falls back to 52W position proxy.
key_findings.batch_c_strategy_stats_works: GET /api/admin/strategy-stats returns 200 with empty strategy_stats list (no trades recorded; expected for new feature). Filter by strategy_id query param works.
key_findings.regression_all_pass: NSE holidays, RELIANCE/HDFCBANK multibagger custom-search, portfolio analyze (RELIANCE+INFY) all return 200 with expected structure.

test_52w_proxy_diff.root_cause: Initial test assumed fundamental_score diff=2 between mid-range and near-high 52W positions. But breadth_score also uses 52W position (BULLISH: near-high=3, mid-range=6). Combined diff = fundamental(2) + breadth(3) = 5. Test corrected to expect diff=5.
